# retired-presence.txt -- the old friend presence, liveness and delivery names that
# are retired and must not come back (the class rule in
# internal/ci/retired_presence_class_test.go, TestNoRetiredPresenceNameReturns).
#
# The owner, 2026-10-14: "continue to remove the old stuff, so they don't come back,
# or get used when using the tool, or building new code" (v1.3.5). The one truth
# for friend liveness is the nova-hook record and its per-minute challenge, only
# the model proves (cmd/nova-hook, docs/SPEC-HOOK.md, tla/Hook.tla); delivery is
# pkg/harness/notice with one shim per harness.
#
# One row per name: `<kind> <name> <what replaced it>`.
#   ident  a Go identifier, matched as a whole word in every .go file
#   verb   a nova-friend verb, matched as `Name: "<name>"` in cmd/nova-friend's .go files
#   text   a command, flag or label, matched in every text file (.go, .md, .sh,
#          .sexp, .txt, .tsv, .yml, .json, .plist, .tla, .cfg), not followed by a
#          letter, digit or underscore
# History is not scanned: CHANGELOG.md, FIXES.md, RESOLUTIONS.md, docs/fixes.sexp,
# docs/RELEASE-NOTES-*, docs/dogfood/, docs/stranger/ and the deleted-tests log.

# the coordinator's one-second keepalive loop (nova-friend serve)
ident PingEvery nova-hook serve's per-minute challenge (hook.BeatEvery)
ident RowsEvery nova-hook serve reads the hooked names each pass
ident NewKeepalive the hook record (hook.Store), two misses unhook
ident PeerUp hook.StateProven
ident PeerDown the hook record's unhooked state
ident friendRows nova-hook friends --json
ident noPeers nova-hook friends --json
verb serve nova-hook serve
text nova-friend serve nova-hook serve
text friend-serve nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent

# the coordinator's ping, the wake ping loop and the pong wait
ident WakeTargets nova-hook serve challenges every hooked name
ident WakeRow nova-hook friends --json
ident DeafChange nova-hook serve's FRIEND DOWN / FRIEND BACK judgment, once per change
ident coordinatorFriends coordinatorSeat (the seat only)
ident wakeFriends nova-hook serve
ident wakePass nova-hook serve
ident wakeFlagProblems nova-hook serve
ident wakeAgent nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
ident pingInstall nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
ident pingUninstall nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
ident waitPong nova-hook friends --json; nova-friend reach waits on its own step's pong
ident WaitPongEvery nova-hook serve's interval
verb ping nova-hook serve's challenge; nova-friend reach to escalate
verb ping-install nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
verb ping-uninstall nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
verb wait-pong nova-hook friends --json; nova-friend reach
text nova-friend ping nova-hook serve's challenge; nova-friend reach to escalate
text nova-friend wait-pong nova-hook friends --json; nova-friend reach
text friend-wake-ping nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
text --to-friends nova-hook serve challenges every hooked name
text --never-wake nova-hook unhook

# the hand beat canary
ident beatVerb the daemon's own beat to the sprint server; liveness is nova-hook's
verb beat the daemon's own beat to the sprint server; liveness is nova-hook's
text nova-friend beat the daemon's own beat to the sprint server; liveness is nova-hook's

# the daemon's session-check presence and its push proof
ident StartPresence the hook record
ident SessionCheck the hook record; only the model's nova-hook prove proves a session
ident roundTripProof the hook record
ident BusGrace the hook record's two-miss rule
ident PushProver the hook record (bus2:push is deleted)
ident PushRenewEvery the hook record
ident ProvePush the hook record
ident PushFresh the hook record
